headline: Former Google chief executive Eric Schmidt said AI coding tools now write code he could not have written at 22, and that programmers will become architects who direct AI.
score_reason: Pool score kept: a well-known voice's view on a work trend; not a new finding.
importance_line: Software workers and students choosing careers may see their jobs shift toward directing AI, though this is Schmidt's opinion and the article itself says he does not call coding useless.
source: Moneycontrol, citing Blackstone's Inside Blackstone podcast
summary: Moneycontrol reports that Eric Schmidt, speaking on Blackstone's Inside Blackstone podcast, said "My field is over" and that tools such as Claude Code and OpenAI Codex can write code he could not have written at 22. He still thinks young people should learn to code, because future developers will decide what software should do while AI does much of the writing.
notes: Podcast date not given; Moneycontrol first published 6 Oct 2026. The article adds context from IEEE Software and McKinsey, which is not Schmidt's.
